title: Technical Report of Auriga's 1:10 Scale Autonomous Vehicle Robot
description:
arXiv:2611.18855v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This report presents the design and implementation of Auriga Robotics' 1:10 scale autonomous vehicle, developed at Shahid Beheshti University's Robotics and Intelligent Automation Laboratory. The platform integrates a custom mechanical chassis, a distributed embedded system based on ESP32 microcontrollers, and a Jetson Orin NX module for high-level perception and control.
